title: domain: unify QualityReport types
description: Consolidate QualityReport, QualityDimension, and QualityIssue into src/domain/quality.rs. This removes the triplication between Lattice, Intent, and UI.

ubiquitous: THE SYSTEM SHALL have one canonical QualityReport for all phases.

event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL use the src/domain/quality.rs types.

unwanted.condition: IF a new dimension is added
unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT require changes in more than one location

postconditions: QualityReport struct is defined in domain
invariants: QualityReport is the only allowed report type in the system

phase_0: Read existing Lattice and Intent report types

title: domain: implement QualityEvaluator trait
description: Define the QualityEvaluator<T> trait to provide a generic interface for scoring different input types (Answers, Specs).

ubiquitous: THE SYSTEM SHALL support generic quality evaluation via traits.

event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL return a Result<QualityReport, ClarityError>.

unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT return a partial or invalid report

invariants: The trait method MUST be pure (no &mut self)

title: domain: define unified Answer type
description: Define the canonical Answer type in src/domain/types.rs to replace all ad-hoc implementations.

ubiquitous: THE SYSTEM SHALL use a single Answer type for all requirements capture.

event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL store it using the domain::Answer struct.

unwanted.condition: IF an answer has no timestamp
unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT allow creation

invariants: Answer IDs must be unique within a session

phase_0: Identify existing Answer fields in storage and UI
